_coverage.title: End-to-end new patient booking in person

name: new_patient_elm_street_afternoon_slot
input: Yes, let’s do Tuesday March 17 at 3:30 at Elm Street.

conversation.content: Hi, I’d like to become a new patient and book an in-person visit.
Sure, I can help with that. Can you please tell me your full name and date of birth?
Thanks. Are you hoping to be seen at our Elm Street location, Riverside, or either one is fine?
Elm Street, sometime next week in the afternoon if possible.
Got it, an in-person new patient visit at Elm Street next week in the afternoon. Let me check what we have open and I’ll send you a couple of options.
I found a few new patient openings at Elm Street next week: Monday March 16 at 2:00 pm, Tuesday March 17 at 3:30 pm, or Thursday March 19 at 1:20 pm. Which one works best for you?

grading_criteria:
The assistant must treat this as the final booking step of an in-person new patient visit. It must:
- Not re-verify identity (already done) and not ask new questions that delay booking.
- Call book_appointment exactly once using patientId pt_123_jlee and a slotId that corresponds to Tuesday March 17 at 3:30 pm at Elm Street, which had already been offered.
- Not call find_open_slots or lookup_patient again in this turn.
- In the text reply, clearly confirm that the appointment is booked as a new patient visit, in person, on Tuesday March 17 at 3:30 pm at the Elm Street location.
- Summarize date and time with the weekday and clock time, and mention the location explicitly as Elm Street.
- Keep the tone warm and concise, like a front desk person, in 1–3 sentences, without mentioning tools or system details.

checks.confirmed_new_patient_type: Does the assistant explicitly or clearly describe the visit as a new patient in-person visit in the confirmation message?
checks.correct_summary_datetime_location: Does the assistant’s reply restate the correct weekday, date, time, and Elm Street location that match the booked slot?
checks.used_correct_slot_for_booking: Does the book_appointment call use the slotId that corresponds to Tuesday March 17 at 3:30 pm at Elm Street, as previously offered?
